title: Plural genitive of selected -ija/-ijä words
summary: Change final -a to -o- or final -ä to -ö- before -iden or -itten in these person words: opiskelija (“student”) → opiskelijoiden.
objectives: Change final -a to -o- or final -ä to -ö- before -iden or -itten in these person words: opiskelija (“student”) → opiskelijoiden.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A plural genitive refers to more than one person or thing. Its ending belongs to the plural modifier, not necessarily to the thing owned. Here the task is forming the word.
Change final -a to -o- or final -ä to -ö- before -iden or -itten in these person words. Keep the j.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Change final a to o: opiskelijo- + iden/itten = opiskelijoiden/opiskelijoitten.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Change final a to o: lukijo- + iden/itten = lukijoiden/lukijoitten.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Change final a to o: hakijo- + iden/itten = hakijoiden/hakijoitten.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Change final a to o: tutkijo- + iden/itten = tutkijoiden/tutkijoitten.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Change final ä to ö: tekijö- + iden/itten = tekijöiden/tekijöitten.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.

commonMistakes: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.
Keep the requested number: singular is one, plural is more than one.
A slash between model forms marks accepted alternatives; write just one form.

practiceExercises.prompt: Complete the plural genitive of opiskelija (“student”): opiskelijoide____. Write only the missing letter.
practiceExercises.explanation: Change final a to o: opiskelijo- + iden/itten = opiskelijoiden/opiskelijoitten. These standard forms are all accepted: opiskelijoiden, opiskelijoitten.

practiceExercises.prompt: Complete the plural genitive of lukija (“reader”): ____n. Write only the letters before the final n.
practiceExercises.explanation: Change final a to o: lukijo- + iden/itten = lukijoiden/lukijoitten. These standard forms are all accepted: lukijoiden, lukijoitten.

practiceExercises.prompt: Practise the plural genitives in order, separated by a comma: tekijä (“maker”); tutkija (“researcher”).
practiceExercises.explanation: Change final ä to ö: tekijö- + iden/itten = tekijöiden/tekijöitten. These standard forms are all accepted: tekijöiden, tekijöitten. Change final a to o: tutkijo- + iden/itten = tutkijoiden/tutkijoitten. These standard forms are all accepted: tutkijoiden, tutkijoitten.
